notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (6): Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room), Podrace Prep, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Seeking An Audience; they count toward the 60. No objective.
Posted 'Rebel Snowspeeder x14 (The destiny 3 ones from hoth 2p game)' dested Rebel Snowspeeder, the Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game card (destiny 3).
Posted 'Savrip' dested the Effect Mantellian Savrip (forfeit cards from hand after losing a battle; the post uses it when the opponent drops many characters).

Posted 'Artoo' dested the Jabba's Palace Artoo (Seeking An Audience deploys R2-D2 and C-3PO from Reserve Deck, as the post describes); 'Threepeo With His Parts Showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing.

Posted 'Tatooine Mos Espa' dested the Light Tatooine site; 'Tatooine Lars Farm' dested Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm; 'Tatooine Hutt Trade Route' dested Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert); 'Yarna dal Gargan' dested the Effect Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'Anakinss Podracer' dested Anakin's Podracer.
The author calls it a pre-Reflections III deck; it went 2-0 at an unnamed local tournament the weekend before posting.
